newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia T-bill yields rise as banks close balances.
newsitem.headline: Russia T-bill yields rise as banks close balances.

text.p: Yields on Russian government paper edged up on Friday in a technical correction as banks needed roubles to close half-year balance sheets, dealers said.
They expect no significant moves through the middle of next week.
*Average yield rose to 19.46 pct from 19.20 pct on Thursday
*Turnover fell to 5.71 trln rbls from 6.03 trln rbls
*Central bank sold 259.3 million rbls of VSM bonds
"The price fall mostly in short and medium-term paper was a technical correction connected to the quarter-end," Vostok-Zapad Bank dealer Andrei Isayev said.
"Most likely we shall see a sidetrend until Thursday as we do not expect significant cash inflows to the market -- pensions are paid off, tax money is paid."
First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais has said the government has made its last money transfer to pay pension arrears.
Dealers said long issues of OFZ interest-bearing bonds series 24005 and 24007 were most actively traded.
